xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4341: An independent, different-family plan critic before finalize for flagged plans

plan.title: An independent, different-family plan critic before finalize for flagged plans
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The critic gate is one feature whose halves are only useful together: the CLI dispatch without the server check leaves the Done button and pan plan done as a bypass, and the server check without the CLI dispatch refuses flagged plans with no way to produce a critique. The subsystem count (src/lib, src/cli, src/dashboard, tests/unit, roles, docs, sync-sources) comes from co-located tests, a role prompt and docs, not from breadth of code change; the plan touches 25 files, at the 25-file limit.

narratives.Problem: The only pre-code critique is pan plan --probe, the planner reviewing its own plan (sync-sources/skills/pan-plan/SKILL.md line 62). Correlated review is not verification: a same-model, same-context critic repeats the planner's blind spots.
narratives.Proposal: For flagged plans (labels architecture, substrate-improvement, security, or --critic), pan plan finalize dispatches one read-only worker on a model family different from the planner's (roles.plan.sub.critic.model), with a fixed prompt (roles/plan-critic.md) that sees only the PRD, the inlined draft xBRIEF and the repo. The dispatcher writes .pan/drafts/<stem>-critique.md whose line 1 is plan-digest: <sha256 of the draft minus lifecycle and stamp fields>. The planner answers each blocks-the-design finding under ## Critique response in the PRD. A pure gate (evaluateCritiqueGate) runs in the CLI and in complete-planning: it refuses on missing, stale (digest mismatch) or unanswered critiques, and after two rounds (counted from the tree and git history) it proceeds and lists unresolved findings in the PRD. Nothing is stored; readiness is derived.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A panel of several critics or Deft's full design-critique arc (envelopes, charters, post caps)
- Fresh re-review lanes or critic-method lines for code review (PAN-4342)
- A Settings page UI for roles.plan.sub.critic (config.yaml and the settings API accept it)
- Enforcing critic isolation beyond the prompt (no sandboxing of .overdeck/)
- Dispatching the critic from the complete-planning server or the dashboard Done button
- A --no-critic bypass flag
- Any default critic model or hardcoded model fallback
- Critique for unflagged plans, or any change to --probe
- Changes to pan worker run or roles/worker.md
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.summary: Dispatch lives in the CLI finalize path; complete-planning only verifies and returns 422
autoDecisions.rationale: The CLI can wait up to 540 s inside the 10-minute foreground limit; the server POST has a 90 s timeout. Verifying on the server closes the Done-button and pan plan done bypass.

autoDecisions.summary: Model family (familyOf: telemetry family, else provider:<name>, else unknown:<model>) is the decorrelation axis, not the harness
autoDecisions.rationale: Decorrelation is about the model; the operator deliberately routes some GPT models through claude-code. The dispatch test still asserts the launched harness equals the resolved critic harness, which catches a dropped --harness.

autoDecisions.summary: The critic model comes only from the new roles.plan.sub.critic.model setting; unset means a loud refusal
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo rule: never hardcode a model fallback. Default workhorses are all Claude, so any derived default would be same-family.

autoDecisions.summary: Unreadable labels warn and treat the plan as unflagged, identically on CLI and server
autoDecisions.rationale: The parent PRD frames these gates as cheap-path prevention, not a security boundary (deft-adoption.md line 12); blocking all finalizes on a tracker outage costs more.

autoDecisions.summary: The dispatcher writes the critique file (with the digest it computed) and does not commit it; rounds count from the working tree or git history
autoDecisions.rationale: The planner pane's git shim interferes with pan git writes and promotion already runs git add .pan/. Counting history too means deleting a committed critique cannot reset the round count.

autoDecisions.summary: Critique files are named from the resolved workspace PRD stem: <stem>-critique.md and <stem>-critique-2.md
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the critique beside the PRD regardless of the legacy uppercase or canonical lowercase draft name.

autoDecisions.summary: No --no-critic flag; exit code 5 means critique-gate refusal
autoDecisions.rationale: Removing the label is the operator's visible bypass; a flag would be an agent cheap path. Codes 1, 3, 4 keep their meaning.

autoDecisions.summary: Worker name plan-critic-r<N> makes finalize re-runs wait on an in-flight critic instead of starting another
autoDecisions.rationale: Derived idempotency from listWorkers facts, no stored state.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/lib/planning/plan-critique.ts with CRITIC_LABELS, MAX_CRITIQUE_ROUNDS=2, parseCritique, answeredCritiqueTitles, isFlaggedByLabels, evaluateCritiqueGate, withUnresolvedSection exactly as typed in the PRD. Finding headings match /^## (blocks-the-design|sharpens-framing|footnote):\s*(.+?)\s*$/. Answers are ### headings under ## Critique response, compared trimmed and lower-cased. Gate order per FR-7: not-required, cap-reached (roundsUsed>=2, unresolved list), missing, stale (digest mismatch or null digest), unanswered, answered. Pure functions only: no fs, no git.
